title: Elysia Desktop Protocol v1
x-elysia-runtimeInvariants: Work result text is at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes; progress is at most 1000 code points and 4000 UTF-8 bytes. Neither accepts NUL or unpaired surrogates
Work options require canonical Work mode; permissions are frozen per generation, only four closed calls are allowed, retries never execute tools, and receipts bind request/chat/call identities
chat.internet.resolve sources contain at most five exact source records with UTF-8 byte limits title 2048, URL 4096, snippet 4096, and compact sources JSON 32768; error is null or sources is empty
Internet source URLs are HTTPS with no credentials, non-default port, backslash, whitespace or control bytes; fetchedAt is canonical valid UTC ISO with milliseconds
Internet query is nonblank and at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes; automaticInternet is Main-only and ignored for Project Sources or non-Chat mode

attachment.native_source returns only canonical Base64 of a verified PNG/JPEG snapshot with decoded size 1..8388608 for a ready active-Chat attachment; Main never forwards this command or bytes to Renderer
progress.total is null or greater than or equal to progress.completed
initializeResult.modelName is present in initializeResult.models
chatStateResult.chats has unique chatId values
chatStateResult.activeChat appears in chats with identical summary fields
chatDetail.messages has unique messageId values and its length equals messageCount
projectStateResult.projects has unique projectId values
projectStateResult.activeProject is null or appears in projects with identical fields
every non-null projectId in projectStateResult.chatState refers to projectStateResult.projects
each Project chatCount equals all matching Chats in projectStateResult.chatState.chats
settingsStateResult.restartRequired is true exactly when restartFields is non-empty
speechReadinessStatus has a reason exactly when managed speech is unavailable
transcriptionModel is an allowlisted directory name resolved only beneath models/weights/faster-whisper
voiceProfileId is a bounded logical identifier and never a filesystem path
transcriptReviewMode remains manual so recognition never sends a Chat message without explicit user review
transcriptionStatus requested and resolved devices, compute type, state, and fallback reason are semantically consistent
stream sequences are contiguous per request and have exactly one terminal chunk
the terminal response reply exactly equals the concatenated stream chunks
request and permission identifiers correlate with live pending operations
attachment.add and knowledge.source.add sourcePaths are unique after Windows separator, dot-segment, and case normalization
voice.capture.complete sampleCount and speech markers are aligned to 320-sample frames
voice.capture.complete speech markers satisfy 0 <= speechStartSample < speechEndSample <= sampleCount and span at least 3200 samples
voice.capture.complete pcmBase64 is strict canonical Base64 whose decoded byte length equals sampleCount * 2
voice.capture results derive durationMs and speechDurationMs exactly from their sample metadata
voice.transcription.start carries each PCM payload exactly once and permits only auto, zh, or en
voice.transcription.start sampleCount and speech markers obey the same frame alignment, bounds, and minimum speech span as voice.capture.complete
voice.transcription.start pcmBase64 is strict canonical Base64 whose decoded byte length equals sampleCount * 2
voice.transcription result text follows the protocol non-blank code-point definition
voice.transcription results contain no PCM, model path, or native error detail
voice.speech.start names one persisted Assistant message by chatId and assistantMessageId and never accepts source text
voice.speech.cancel targets one managed speech turn by the exact requestId and chatId pair
voice.speech.clip metadata exactly matches the next private binary frame before playback
voice.speech events contain no source text, model path, profile, cache state, or native error detail
voice.speech.terminal satisfies failedSentences <= completedSentences <= submittedSentences and completed state has equal completed/submitted counts
image.generate accepts only exclusive original-character or confirmed adult Elysia identities, with no content mode, policy toggle, arbitrary intent, path, model, or workflow selector
image.generate loras preserves caller order and rejects repeated loraId values even when their strengths differ; JSON Schema uniqueItems alone cannot express this property-level uniqueness
image.generate progress uses only the six exact stage/percent pairs and completed is emitted only after Gallery commit
image Gallery lists contain unique artifacts in descending createdAt and artifactId order, and hasMore requires a full page
image artifact dimensions satisfy width * height <= 4194304 and timestamps are timezone-aware
image.gallery.open metadata exactly matches the next private PNG frame and its nonzero previewToken is single-use
knowledge.state sources and operations have unique identifiers and every operation belongs to the enclosing Project
every non-null knowledge.state source operationId refers to an operation in the same result
knowledge operation timestamps are timezone-aware and updatedAt never precedes createdAt
knowledge operation event projectId equals its operation projectId and completed events carry a terminal operation
groundedAnswer statement IDs and citation IDs are unique and citations form the exact closed union referenced by statements
an answered groundedAnswer has contextPassageCount greater than zero and every source_fact text is an exact contiguous substring of every cited excerpt
groundedAnswer aggregate statement text is at most 16000 Unicode code points and aggregate citation locations are at most 100000
groundedAnswer text ranges satisfy sourceStartCodePoint < sourceEndCodePoint; table ranges permit equality
groundedAnswer is present only on assistant Chat messages and never exposes paths, hashes, or private storage lineage
